flow.transformation: Shell expands secret into openssl -hmac argument

evidence: tests/sdd-sudo-guard-mutation.tests.py: actual doc signer, three key-source precedence controls, BOM/trailing-space file normalization, two fail-closed failures, RFC4231 case2, process argv inspection.
